name: Lilith
abilities: Nyxara: Infernal Debt Verdict Dominion Grid
passives: Blood Contract: Nyxara gains Debtfire when controller play rewrites movement lanes, delays elite intent, and imprints safe/unsafe tiles on contract-scorched court ground. At 3 stacks, the next Technique or Reaction adds a debt, clause, and dominion law rider; at 5 stacks, the Signature upgrades once and then empties the meter. Momentum feeds the setup, Divinity empowers the finisher, and Earth myth remains only the echo of Infernal Dominion.
lore: Lilith, Night Sovereign, is now canonized as one of the four playable deities of Infernal Dominion. The deity is the source-realm divinity behind the mythology rather than a generic champion: night demon queen, sovereign refusal, seduction, storm of forbidden names and boundary law. All prior faction, realm, civilization, campaign, and Lore Codex canon remains intact; only the playable roster scale and divine identity layer changed.
personality: A playable mythology deity whose behavior expresses night demon queen, sovereign refusal, seduction, storm of forbidden names and boundary law; confident, sovereign, readable in combat, loyal to the unchanged Infernal Dominion canon.
visualDescription: Lilith manifests as night demon queen, sovereign refusal, seduction, storm of forbidden names and boundary law from Infernal Dominion: alluring dangerous feminine queen face, dark almond eyes, full lips, arched brows, hypnotic confidence; sensual powerful feminine frame, narrow waist, pronounced hips, elegant predatory posture; signature silhouette: long horn crown, bat-silk hair mantle, whip crescent, queenly night outline. Weapon: thorned moon whip and obsidian mirror dagger. Maintain the approved Mythos Gates premium stylized tactical RPG aesthetic.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Nyxara — Black-Iron Clause Cut Vector
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Infernal Dominion source-culture damage at range 4; generate Momentum and a small Contract Debt gain when used from black-iron contract ground or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as black iron crowns, volcanic glass, contract parchment, chain mantles, blood wax seals, horn hierarchy, ash velvet, hellfire clauses.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Blood-Wax Contract Technique — Field Rewrite
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to moves enemies, rewrites terrain pressure, and delays high-threat actions through source-culture law. Builds Contract Debt only when the player uses black-iron contract ground intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Nyxara: Infernal Debt Verdict Dominion Grid
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Contract Debt to impose a two-round rule from Infernal Dominion: moves enemies, rewrites terrain pressure, and delays high-threat actions through source-culture law. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Hell-Crown Dominion Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Contract Debt, transform nearby terrain into black-iron contract ground, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Nyxara Compass Goetic Chain-Crown Blade
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through black-iron contract ground. Visual: black iron crowns, volcanic glass, contract parchment, chain mantles, blood wax seals, horn hierarchy, ash velvet, hellfire clauses.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Nyxara Volcanic Glass Debtor Plate
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Infernal Dominion source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the player followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Nyxara Blood-Wax Infernal Ledger Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Contract Debt and unlocks a mastery branch for Infernal Clause Step, Chain-Lien Reversal, and Collect the Soul Clause. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: reshape terrain and deny enemy plans
balanceNotes.uniqueMechanic: Nyxara's Blood Contract: a solo mechanic where Debtfire grows through contract-scorched court ground, reaction-window mastery, and controller decisions that rewrite movement lanes, delay elite intent, and imprint safe/unsafe tiles. Payoff: turn enemy pathing into objective tempo instead of raw crowd control. Counterplay: mobile enemies and line-of-sight denial reduce control value; enemies can also drain Momentum/Divinity before the upgraded Signature resolves.
balanceNotes.counterplayRule: mobile enemies and line-of-sight denial reduce control value
